name: univer-integrate
title: univer-integrate
description: Embed Office-like Sheets and Docs editing (formulas, Facade APIs, plugin system) into a web app — the official Univer SDK skill, with framework templates for React, Vue, plain HTML and Node.
why: The collection has no office / document-editing / spreadsheet entry — this capability was genuinely missing. Main repo dream-num/univer has 30,832 stars (Apache-2.0). Version note: written for Univer v0.21.x; current Univer is v1.5.2 — the plugin-mode API it teaches (new Univer() + registerPlugins, createUnit) is still valid, and the newer recommended quick start is presets (createUniver + UniverSheetsCorePreset). Honest limit: charts, pivot tables, Slides and real-time collaboration are commercial Pro features, not open source.
requires: Web app project (React, Vue or plain HTML)
